fusions.name: Many Hooves
fusions.desc: A stamping blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Eightfold Thrash
fusions.desc: Looses 8 flailing strikes in a spread, each dealing 3 damage and knocking the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Wrapped Up
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Reaching Limb
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar that fights beside you, striking for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds against enemies within 5 tiles.
